name: search_biomedical_articles
description: Search for biomedical articles related to a specific disease name in a literature database. Returns a ranked list of article metadata including title, authors, journal, publication year, and abstract. Use this tool when the user requests information on biomedical literature related to a disease. Do NOT use for non-biomedical topics or general literature searches; for those, consider using a general search tool.

parameters.name: disease_name
parameters.description: The name of the disease to search for in the literature. Should be a complete disease name or term, e.g., 'diabetes mellitus'.

parameters.name: max_results
parameters.description: Maximum number of articles to return, ranked by relevance. Must be between 1 and 100. Defaults to 20 if not specified.

parameters.name: min_year
parameters.description: Earliest publication year to include (inclusive), as a 4-digit year e.g. 2020. Articles published before this year are excluded. Omit to include all years.

articles.description: List of matching articles, ranked by relevance. Each item has: title (string), authors (array of strings), journal (string), year (integer), abstract (string).

total_count.description: Total number of matches in the database, which may exceed max_results.

return_schema.description: Object containing 'articles' (list of metadata) and 'total_count' (total matches before truncation).
